assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of recurrent syncope and transient episodes of cerebral ischemia, raising concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology.
Given the known diagnosis of sick sinus syndrome (I49.5).
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential bradyarrhythmias or pauses.
This service is medically necessary to evaluate the suspected arrhythmic cause of the patient's recurrent syncope (R55).
